```{r}
)

for(i in seq_len(nrow(comp_mat))){

  comp_traj <- as.numeric(
    comp_mat[i, ]
  )

  for(j in seq_len(nrow(tax_mat))){

    tax_traj <- as.numeric(
      tax_mat[j, ]
    )

    if(
      sd(comp_traj) > 0 &
      sd(tax_traj) > 0
    ){

      cor_mat[i,j] <- suppressWarnings(
        cor(
          comp_traj,
          tax_traj,
          method = "spearman"
        )
      )

    } else {

      cor_mat[i,j] <- 0
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Compound annotations
# -----------------------------------------------------

row_info <- resp %>%
  select(
    Compound,
    Response
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Compound %in% rownames(cor_mat)
  )

row_info <- row_info[
  match(
    rownames(cor_mat),
    row_info$Compound
  ),
]

row_ha <- rowAnnotation(

  Response = row_info$Response,

  col = list(
    Response = c(
      "Emergent" = "#49006A",
      "Enhanced" = "#C51B8A",
      "Reduced" = "grey60",
      "No substantial response" = "#D9D9D9"
    )
  ),

  width = unit(4, "mm")
)

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Colour palette
# -----------------------------------------------------

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-1, 0, 1),
  c(
    "#2166AC",
    "white",
    "#B2182B"
  )
)

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Heatmap
# -----------------------------------------------------

ht <- Heatmap(

  cor_mat,

  name = "Spearman rho",

  col = col_fun,

  right_annotation = row_ha,

  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,

  row_names_side = "left",
  row_split = row_info$Response, 
  row_names_gp = gpar(
    fontsize = 7
  ),

  column_names_gp = gpar(
    fontsize = 8,
    fontface = "italic"
  ),

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = expression(rho)
  ),

  row_title = "Biodegradable compounds",
  column_title = "ANCOM-significant genera"
)

draw(ht)
```

### Supplementary Figure S5: All biodegradable compounds × ANCOM taxa network

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)

# =====================================================
# Supplementary Figure S5
# All biodegradable compounds × ANCOM taxa network
# =====================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Keep strong associations
# -----------------------------------------------------

strong_edges <- assoc_tbl %>%
  filter(abs(Rho) >= 0.9)

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Compound response category
# -----------------------------------------------------

compound_info <- resp %>%
  select(
    Compound,
    Response
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Taxa nodes
# -----------------------------------------------------

taxa_nodes <- tibble(
  name = unique(strong_edges$Taxon),
  type = "Taxon"
)

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Compound nodes
# -----------------------------------------------------

compound_nodes <- tibble(
  name = unique(strong_edges$Compound)
) %>%
  left_join(
    compound_info,
    by = c("name" = "Compound")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    type = "Compound"
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Combine nodes
# -----------------------------------------------------

nodes <- bind_rows(
  taxa_nodes,
  compound_nodes
)

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Edges
# -----------------------------------------------------

edges <- strong_edges %>%
  mutate(
    Association = ifelse(
      Rho > 0,
      "Positive",
      "Negative"
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    from = match(
      Taxon,
      nodes$name
    ),
    to = match(
      Compound,
      nodes$name
    ),
    rho = abs(Rho),
    Association
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Graph
# -----------------------------------------------------

graph <- tbl_graph(
  nodes = nodes,
  edges = edges,
  directed = FALSE
)

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Figure S5
# -----------------------------------------------------

pS5 <- ggraph(
  graph,
  layout = "kk"
) +

  # -----------------------------------------
  # Edges
  # -----------------------------------------

  geom_edge_link(
    aes(
      colour = Association,
      width = rho
    ),
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +

  scale_edge_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      Positive = "#B2182B",
      Negative = "#2166AC"
    )
  ) +

  scale_edge_width(
    range = c(0.8, 2.5)
  ) +

  # -----------------------------------------
  # Taxa
  # -----------------------------------------

  geom_node_point(
    data = function(x)
      dplyr::filter(
        x,
        type == "Taxon"
      ),
    shape = 21,
    fill = "#5AAE61",
    colour = "black",
    size = 5,
    stroke = 0.5
  ) +

  # -----------------------------------------
  # Compounds
  # -----------------------------------------

  geom_node_point(
    data = function(x)
      dplyr::filter(
        x,
        type == "Compound"
      ),
    aes(
      fill = Response
    ),
    shape = 22,
    colour = "black",
    size = 5,
    stroke = 0.5
  ) +

  # -----------------------------------------
  # Labels
  # -----------------------------------------

  geom_node_text(
    aes(
      label = name
    ),
    size = 3,
    repel = TRUE
  ) +

  # -----------------------------------------
  # Response colours
  # -----------------------------------------

  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Response category",
    values = c(
      "Emergent" = "#49006A",
      "Enhanced" = "#C51B8A",
      "Reduced" = "#3182BD",
      "No substantial response" = "#D9D9D9"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    edge_colour = "Association",
    edge_width = expression("|" * rho * "|")
  ) +

  theme_void(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "right",

    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 10
    )
  )

pS5
```

## Others: Supplementary information

### Table S5: Alpha-diversity statistics

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(rstatix)
library(openxlsx)

# ====================================================
# TABLE S5
# Alpha-diversity statistics
# ====================================================

# Metadata + alpha diversity
alpha <- mco$alpha_diversity %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  left_join(
    mco$sample_table %>%
      rownames_to_column("Sample"),
    by = "Sample"
  )

# Keep only treatments used in Fig. 1
alpha <- alpha %>%
  filter(
    Category %in% c(
      "Field",
      "Spike - 0 h",
      "Spike - 24 h",
      "Spike - 48 h",
      "Spike - 72 h"
    )
  )

# Order
alpha$Category <- factor(
  alpha$Category,
  levels = c(
    "Field",
    "Spike - 0 h",
    "Spike - 24 h",
    "Spike - 48 h",
    "Spike - 72 h"
  )
)

# ====================================================
# Summary statistics
# ====================================================

metrics <- c(
  "Observed",
  "Shannon",
  "Pielou"
)

summary.list <- list()

for(m in metrics){

  tmp <- alpha %>%
    group_by(Category) %>%
    summarise(
      Metric = m,
      Mean = mean(.data[[m]], na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(.data[[m]], na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = median(.data[[m]], na.rm = TRUE),
      Min = min(.data[[m]], na.rm = TRUE),
      Max = max(.data[[m]], na.rm = TRUE),
      N = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  summary.list[[m]] <- tmp
}

summary.tab <- bind_rows(summary.list)

# ====================================================
# Kruskal-Wallis
# ====================================================

kw.list <- list()

for(m in metrics){

  kw <- kruskal.test(
    alpha[[m]] ~ alpha$Category
  )

  kw.list[[m]] <- data.frame(
    Metric = m,
    ChiSquare = as.numeric(kw$statistic),
    DF = as.numeric(kw$parameter),
    Pvalue = kw$p.value
  )
}

kw.tab <- bind_rows(kw.list)

# ====================================================
# Dunn post hoc tests
# ====================================================

pair.list <- list()

for(m in metrics){

  res <- alpha %>%
    dunn_test(
      formula = as.formula(
        paste(m, "~ Category")
      ),
      p.adjust.method = "BH"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Metric = m
    )

  pair.list[[m]] <- res
}

pair.tab <- bind_rows(pair.list)

# ====================================================
# Export to Excel
# ====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "Summary")
writeData(
  wb,
  "Summary",
  summary.tab
)

addWorksheet(wb, "KruskalWallis")
writeData(
  wb,
  "KruskalWallis",
  kw.tab
)

addWorksheet(wb, "DunnTest")
writeData(
  wb,
  "DunnTest",
  pair.tab
)

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "Supplementary_Table_S5_AlphaDiversity.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# ====================================================
# Optional: inspect results
# ====================================================

summary.tab
kw.tab
pair.tab
```

### Table S6: Community composition analyses

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(openxlsx)
library(tibble)

# ====================================================
# TABLE S6
# Community composition analyses
# ====================================================

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Samples used in conditioning analysis
# ----------------------------------------------------

keep_samples <- rownames(
  subset(
    mco$sample_table,
    Category %in% c(
      "Field",
      "Spike - 0 h",
      "Spike - 24 h",
      "Spike - 48 h",
      "Spike - 72 h"
    )
  )
)

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Metadata
# ----------------------------------------------------

meta <- mco$sample_table[
  keep_samples,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

meta$Category <- factor(
  meta$Category,
  levels = c(
    "Field",
    "Spike - 0 h",
    "Spike - 24 h",
    "Spike - 48 h",
    "Spike - 72 h"
  )
)

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Bray-Curtis PERMANOVA
# ----------------------------------------------------

bray <- as.dist(
  mco$beta_diversity$bray[
    keep_samples,
    keep_samples
  ]
)

perm.bray <- adonis2(
  bray ~ Category,
  data = meta,
  permutations = 999
)

bray.tab <- as.data.frame(perm.bray) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Term")

wuni <- as.dist(
  mco$beta_diversity$wei_unifrac[

  ]
)

perm.wuni <- adonis2(

)

)

)

wuni.tab
```

### Table S7: Indicator taxa

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(indicspecies)
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(openxlsx)

# ====================================================
# TABLE S7
# Indicator taxa
# ====================================================

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Convert to phyloseq object
# ----------------------------------------------------

ps <- file2meco::meco2phyloseq(mco)

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Keep Field + Spike samples only
# ----------------------------------------------------

keep <- sample_names(ps)[
  sample_data(ps)$Category %in% c(
    "Field",
    "Spike - 0 h",
    "Spike - 24 h",
    "Spike - 48 h",
    "Spike - 72 h"
  )
]

ps <- prune_samples(keep, ps)

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Aggregate to genus level
# ----------------------------------------------------

ps.gen <- tax_glom(
  ps,
  taxrank = "Genus",
  NArm = FALSE
)

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Extract abundance table
# ----------------------------------------------------

otu <- as.data.frame(
  otu_table(ps.gen)
)

if(!taxa_are_rows(ps.gen)){
  otu <- t(otu)
}

otu <- as.data.frame(otu)

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Taxonomy
# ----------------------------------------------------

tax <- as.data.frame(
  tax_table(ps.gen)
)

tax$Genus <- as.character(
  tax$Genus
)

tax$Genus <- gsub(
  "^g__",
  "",
  tax$Genus
)

tax$Genus[
  is.na(tax$Genus) |
  tax$Genus == ""
] <- "Unclassified"

rownames(otu) <- make.unique(
  tax$Genus
)

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Metadata
# ----------------------------------------------------

meta <- as.data.frame(
  sample_data(ps.gen)
)

group <- factor(
  meta$Category,
  levels = c(
    "Field",
    "Spike - 0 h",
    "Spike - 24 h",
    "Spike - 48 h",
    "Spike - 72 h"
  )
)

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Indicator species analysis
# ----------------------------------------------------

ind <- multipatt(
  t(otu),
  group,
  func = "IndVal.g",
  control = how(
    nperm = 999
  )
)

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Full results
# ----------------------------------------------------

full.tab <- ind$sign %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Genus")

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Determine indicator treatment
# -----------------------------------------------------

grp.cols <- grep(
  "^s\\.",
  names(full.tab),
  value = TRUE
)

# Convert to matrix
grp.mat <- as.matrix(
  full.tab[, grp.cols]
)

# Determine the group with the highest indicator value
full.tab$IndicatorGroup <- apply(
  grp.mat,
  1,
  function(x){
    grp.cols[which.max(as.numeric(x))]
  }
)

full.tab$IndicatorGroup <- gsub(
  "^s\\.",
  "",
  full.tab$IndicatorGroup
)

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Significant taxa only
# ----------------------------------------------------

sig.tab <- full.tab %>%
  filter(
    p.value < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    p.value
  )

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ----------------------------------------------------

wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(
  wb,
  "All Indicator Taxa"
)

writeData(
  wb,
  "All Indicator Taxa",
  full.tab
)

addWorksheet(
  wb,
  "Significant Taxa"
)

writeData(
  wb,
  "Significant Taxa",
  sig.tab
)

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "Supplementary_Table_S7_IndicatorTaxa.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Inspect
# ----------------------------------------------------

head(sig.tab)
```

### Table S8: ANCOM-BC2 Results

```{r}
library(ANCOMBC)
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(openxlsx)
library(ggrepel)

# ====================================================
# TABLE S8
# ANCOM-BC2 Results
# ====================================================

# ANCOM object already generated in Figure 3E

res <- ancom.out$res

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Sheet 1
# Full ANCOM output
# ----------------------------------------------------

full.tab <- res

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Sheet 2
# Summary table
# Largest response per genus
# ----------------------------------------------------

lfc_cols <- grep(
  "^lfc_",
  names(res),
  value = TRUE
)

q_cols <- grep(
  "^q_",
  names(res),
  value = TRUE
)

summary.tab <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(res)),
  function(i){

    lfc <- as.numeric(
      res[i, lfc_cols]
    )

    q <- as.numeric(
      res[i, q_cols]
    )

    best <- which.max(
      abs(lfc)
    )

    tibble(
      Genus = res$taxon[i],
      Treatment = lfc_cols[best],
      Log2FC = lfc[best],
      Qvalue = q[best],
      Significant = q[best] < 0.05
    )
  }
)

summary.tab <- summary.tab %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = gsub(
      "^g__",
      "",
      Genus
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Qvalue
  )

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Significant genera only
# ----------------------------------------------------

sig.tab <- summary.tab %>%
  filter(
    Significant == TRUE
  )

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Export workbook
# ----------------------------------------------------

wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(
  wb,
  "Full ANCOM Output"
)

writeData(
  wb,
  "Full ANCOM Output",
  full.tab
)

addWorksheet(
  wb,
  "Summary"
)

writeData(
  wb,
  "Summary",
  summary.tab
)

addWorksheet(
  wb,
  "Significant Genera"
)

writeData(
  wb,
  "Significant Genera",
  sig.tab
)

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "Supplementary_Table_S8_ANCOMBC2.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# Inspect
head(sig.tab)
```

### Table S9: Compound-taxon associations

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)

# =====================================================
# TABLE S9
# Compound-taxon associations
# =====================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Convert correlation matrix to long format
# -----------------------------------------------------

assoc.tab <- as.data.frame(
  as.table(cor_mat)
)

colnames(assoc.tab) <- c(
  "Compound",
  "Taxon",
  "SpearmanRho"
)

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Sort by strength
# -----------------------------------------------------

assoc.tab <- assoc.tab %>%
  arrange(
    desc(abs(SpearmanRho))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Association = case_when(
      SpearmanRho > 0 ~ "Positive",
      SpearmanRho < 0 ~ "Negative",
      TRUE ~ "Neutral"
    )
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Strong associations
# Used in heatmap interpretation
# -----------------------------------------------------

strong.tab <- assoc.tab %>%
  filter(
    abs(SpearmanRho) >= 0.8
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Very strong associations
# Used for network analysis
# -----------------------------------------------------

network.tab <- assoc.tab %>%
  filter(
    abs(SpearmanRho) >= 0.9
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Export workbook
# -----------------------------------------------------

wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(
  wb,
  "All Associations"
)

writeData(
  wb,
  "All Associations",
  assoc.tab
)

addWorksheet(
  wb,
  "Strong Associations"
)

writeData(
  wb,
  "Strong Associations",
  strong.tab
)

addWorksheet(
  wb,
  "Network Associations"
)

writeData(
  wb,
  "Network Associations",
  network.tab
)

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "Supplementary_Table_S9_CompoundTaxonAssociations.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# Inspect
head(assoc.tab)
head(strong.tab)
head(network.tab)
```
